1.title: Two US troops killed and one missing after Iranian attack in Jordan
1.summary: Iran and the US have traded strikes as hostilities re-escalated this week, with Tehran targeting US military facilities across the Gulf region.

2.title: Cindy Burbank, Nebraska’s Democratic Senate Nominee, Files to Withdraw From Race
2.summary: The move by Cindy Burbank could clear a path for Dan Osborn, an independent candidate backed by her party’s leadership. But Republicans have cried foul, and her effort could face obstacles.

3.title: These AIPAC-Backed Democrats Voted to Nix Israel Aid. AIPAC Punished Them.
3.summary: Of the 103 Democrats who voted to eliminate aid to Israel, more than a dozen had been endorsed by the pro-Israel lobbying group. AIPAC quickly closed off online donations for them.

4.title: Iran War Live Updates: 2 U.S. Soldiers Killed and 1 Service Member Missing in Iranian Attack on Jordan
4.summary: The soldiers were the first U.S. troops to die from hostile fire in the region since an early April truce. The deaths came as both sides expanded the scope and intensity of their attacks.

6.title: Ukraine’s Top General Becomes a Target of Protesters’ Anger
6.summary: Demonstrators supporting Ukraine’s ousted defense minister have begun denouncing the commander he clashed with in office, Gen. Oleksandr Syrskyi.
